title: PR8061 Staging Gateway Governance Authority Store boundary repair

phases.objective: Preserve the Runtime/Governance database ownership boundary for the Staging Activation Gateway while keeping production mutation, provider mutation, SQL/GRANT changes, and deployment outside this pull request.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Build the Staging Activation Gateway rollout plan with distinct Runtime and Governance query executors.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Governance-owned authority bindings are resolved only through the Governance executor, Runtime-owned workspace reads remain on Runtime DB, and no provider or production mutation occurs.
steps: Classify the shared runtime change against canonical environment-impact policy.
Execute the registered Activation Gateway rollout surface regression in dry-run mode.
Verify platform_resource_authority_bindings never reaches the Runtime executor.
Verify workspace_registry remains a Runtime DB read.
Verify a Runtime executor cannot be reused as the Governance Authority Store.
Require live Staging certification before any governed Staging apply path is considered complete.
assertions: The environment impact declaration source of truth is the canonical deployment branch policy.
Both staging and production are explicitly declared because the changed runtime module is shared, and cross-environment review is explicit.
The Runtime DB does not serve platform_resource_authority_bindings.
No SQL/GRANT changes, Cloudflare/provider writes, Production deployment, or Production mutation are introduced.
